title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Recycled Paper Production Process
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which used paper is collected and turned into new paper products at a recycling facility. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 1 流程图练习。请先花约 2 分钟读图，确认流程的起点、终点以及各阶段的先后顺序；写作时用一般现在时和被动语态描述步骤，并用恰当的连接词（first, next, after that, finally）串联全过程。注意概括主要特征并进行必要比较，不要加入个人观点或解释原因。图中所有场景与数据均为模拟，非官方雅思试题。建议写完后检查字数是否达到 150 词。

figure.title: Recycled Paper Production Process
steps: Used paper is collected from homes and offices and delivered to the recycling facility
Paper is sorted by hand to remove plastic, metal and other non-paper materials
Sorted paper is shredded into small strips
Shredded paper is mixed with water and chemicals to form a pulp
The pulp is heated and pressed to remove ink and impurities
The cleaned pulp is spread and rolled into thin sheets
The sheets are dried and cut to the required size
Finished recycled paper is packed and sent to manufacturers
